title: Observation (simulator -> agent input)
description: engine.Observation as serialised by the engine's Jackson mapper (results.Canonical.MAPPER.valueToTree, sorted keys). The engine never writes Observations to disk; this is the canonical JSON form of the record that Game.observation(...) builds for one agent before it calls Agent.decide. Every field is always present; nullable fields are written as null. Phase 1: no 'messages' field (see INTERFACES.md section i for the planned optional extension).

agentIds.description: All roster ids in roster order (GameConfig.agents), self included; size = market.n.

history.description: Completed rounds, oldest first: the last HistoryPolicy.window rounds (all when window <= 0). Empty in round 1.

choiceDraw.description: One uniform on [0,1) from the agent's own stream choice:<selfId>, drawn every round whether used or not.

ownQuote.description: Own displayed half-spread after engine snapping (QuoteGrid.snap): on the grid s0 + j*quoteIncrement, in [s0, sBar].

ownHiddenFill.description: Own hidden fill price after snapping, strictly below ownQuote; null when none was quoted or it was dropped by Game.sanitize.

quotesVisible.description: Whether this round's displayed quotes were shown to this agent: the uniform from signal:<selfId> drawn at the start of the following round is < observation.o. Fixed once drawn.

rivalQuotes.description: Displayed quotes of every other agent keyed by id (sorted). Empty object when quotesVisible is false. Hidden fills are never shown.

insideQuote.description: Displayed inside (best) quote of the round over the non-excluded agents (RoundRecord.insideQuote); the agent itself is included unless it was excluded that round; null when quotesVisible is false.

ownVolume.description: Observed own volume = true volume + demandNoiseSd * z (z standard normal from demand:<selfId>); volume units; can be negative under noise; null when observation.showOwnVolume is false.

ownFillPrice.description: Own volume-weighted average execution price (half-spread units); null when observation.showFillPrice is false or the agent had zero true volume.

ownExcluded.description: Whether penance routing excluded this agent from contestable flow that round.
